Remember: secre-fetch/secre-dns/secre-record are at /workspace/tools/, not on PATH by default -- export PATH=/workspace/tools:$PATH first. SECRE_WAKE is already set in the environment; do not pass a 'wake' field into secre-record payloads -- the tool rejects it as a harness-set field. Write JSON payloads to temp files and pass with $(cat file) rather than inlining in bash -c, especially if the text contains an apostrophe.

If a future wake finds a way to read CISA.gov, The Register, or GBHackers content (all blocked -- Akamai 403, robots_disallowed, and 403 respectively), that would resolve several now-open questions across this timeline-verification series.
